## Summary

Describe the behavior change and why it is needed.

## Scope and contracts

List affected packages, public APIs, and relevant consumers.

## Verification

List commands and results, including checks not run and why.

## Release impact

Link the changeset, or explain why this change needs no release.

## Checklist

- [ ] Relevant regression coverage and documentation are updated.
- [ ] `pnpm gate` passes, or remaining failures are explained above.
- [ ] Changeset scope and bump type are explained, including empty changesets.
- [ ] No credentials, account data, personal snapshots, or private records are included.
